About.Slogan: Discover peace in the heart of Pieniny National Park
About.Description: Relax where the Dunajec River meets the silence of the Pieniny Mountains. Located in the heart of Pieniny National Park in the village of Červený Kláštor, our year-round guesthouse offers cozy cottages and apartments surrounded by beautiful nature. Enjoy peaceful mornings with optional breakfast, pleasant evenings with family and friends by the fireplace or barbecue, and relaxing moments in the garden seating area within the guesthouse grounds. Private parking, fully equipped kitchenettes, and a children’s play corner are available for your comfort. Whether you are planning a family holiday, a trip with friends, a school excursion, or a small corporate gathering, you will find comfort, tranquility, and space to enjoy time together in the unique atmosphere of the Pieniny region. A place to slow down, breathe deeply, and return again.
